subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing poetic form and meter and their contribution to meaning
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student claps or taps out a poem's rhythm to identify its meter pattern
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a poem's structure to its correct form (sonnet, free verse, ballad)
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a poem's form or meter contributes to its overall meaning or effect

misconception_flags: identifies a poem's form correctly but cannot connect it to any effect on meaning

interest_binding: poem content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
